initial_requirements: Researchers need a standalone application for playing and extending combinatorial games based on triangulations. Players with varying technical experience should be able to choose among several game types and play alone, against computer-controlled opponents, or with another person through an accessible graphical interface. Game developers should also be able to define new games and make them available without modifying the original application.

turns.interviewee_utterance: The core need is a flexible environment for exploring combinatorial games built on triangulations, without forcing researchers or developers to keep rebuilding the tooling from scratch. We want something that lets people play, test ideas, and compare strategies in a way that is accessible enough for non-technical players, but still extensible for game designers and researchers. The main goal is to make it easy to define new triangulation-based game variants and let them run in the same application, ideally without changing the base program each time.
